## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A committed execute driver core drives ExecutionAdapter end to end with no...

The system SHALL ensure that a committed execute driver core drives ExecutionAdapter end to end with no harness-specific code in it.

#### Scenario: A committed execute driver core drives ExecutionAdapter end to end with no...

WHEN `add-supervise-execute-driver-and-host-bindings` is implemented
THEN A committed execute driver core drives ExecutionAdapter end to end with no harness-specific code in it.

### Requirement: A binding is accepted only when the supervised-dispatch and...

The system SHALL ensure that a binding is accepted only when the supervised-dispatch and dispatch-contract e2e suites pass against it in place of their fakes.

#### Scenario: A binding is accepted only when the supervised-dispatch and...

WHEN `add-supervise-execute-driver-and-host-bindings` is implemented
THEN A binding is accepted only when the supervised-dispatch and dispatch-contract e2e suites pass against it in place of their fakes.

### Requirement: The supervisor deterministically detects a missing binding for its harness...

The system SHALL ensure that the supervisor deterministically detects a missing binding for its harness identity, runs with an ephemeral binding, records a host_binding_ephemeral degradation, and emits a candidate-work stub for the binding.

#### Scenario: The supervisor deterministically detects a missing binding for its harness...

WHEN `add-supervise-execute-driver-and-host-bindings` is implemented
THEN The supervisor deterministically detects a missing binding for its harness identity, runs with an ephemeral binding, records a host_binding_ephemeral degradation, and emits a candidate-work stub for the binding.

### Requirement: A local Claude Code binding (GX10) is committed and used by a subsequent...

The system SHALL ensure that a local Claude Code binding (GX10) is committed and used by a subsequent /supervise execute run without regenerating driver code.

#### Scenario: A local Claude Code binding (GX10) is committed and used by a subsequent...

WHEN `add-supervise-execute-driver-and-host-bindings` is implemented
THEN A local Claude Code binding (GX10) is committed and used by a subsequent /supervise execute run without regenerating driver code.
